question: How is the supreme power related to the Lord called Akula?
premises: His supreme power manifests the spreading of Kula.
The Lord is never separated from this power.
inference: The supreme Kaulikī power is the inseparable dynamic by which Akula manifests as Kula.
uncertainties: Akula and Kula carry technical tantric meanings not fully explicit in the verse.
plain_english: Of this Lord Akula, the supreme power is Kaulikī, who shines in the spreading forth of Kula; the Lord is never separated from her.
